exposure: fetal reduction of triplet pregnancies to singleton
cohort: 285 trichorionic and dichorionic triplet pregnancies who underwent abdominal fetal reduction at 11-14 weeks gestation
finding: Triplet pregnancies reduced to singletons had a later delivery and lower rates of preterm delivery and Cesarean section compared to those reduced to twins.
mod_finding: Triplet pregnancies reduced to twins had a higher prevalence of cesarean section compared with triplets reduced to singletons.
